eligibility.quote: Component 'panda_1_FrankaHardwareInterface' did not accept new command resource combination:
eligibility.reason: E1/E4: the public log shows panda_1 rejecting a request containing panda_3 interfaces. E2: the host/plugin callback boundary has incompatible assumptions about which interface keys are supplied. The units are separately deployable host and plugin; this is not a name collision or internal arithmetic. E3: PAIR describes the callback request/result interaction.

failed_conditions.quote:
* \note All starting and stopping interface keys are passed to all components, so the function
   * should return return_type::OK by default when given interface keys not relevant for this
   * component.
failed_conditions.reason: The declared callback contract permits foreign keys and requires the plugin to accept irrelevant ones. The reproduced refusal is an API behavioral-contract mismatch, so other is justified. prepare_command_mode_switch is the point of refusal; no observed perform_command_mode_switch failure is established.

supporting_evidence.quote: Switching between control modes without stopping it first is not supported.

loudness.quote: Could not switch controllers since prepare command mode switch was rejected.
loudness.reason: This is an explicit controller activation refusal from existing tooling.

detection_stage.quote: using a second robot the initialization of the second controller (_panda_3_arm_controller_) fails:
detection_stage.reason: The failure occurs while enabling the additional controller and preparing its command-mode switch.

resolution.quote: This PR makes sure that the start and stop interfaces in perform_command_mode_switch and prepare_command_mode_switch methods of the Hardware components will receive only the interfaces they expose, instead of all of them as of now.
resolution.reason: Per-component filtering addresses the mismatch, but the inspected sources do not demonstrate this exact Franka plugin and resolved framework revision working together. The reported MoveIt controller-manager workaround is not that resolved composition. recommended remains appropriate.

supporting_evidence.quote: When I switch the controller manager to the moveit_simple_controller_manager/MoveItSimpleControllerManager this problem disappears.

notes: The primary Humble header matters: passing all keys was documented behavior, so this should not be described as ros2_control violating its own then-current callback contract. The Franka plugin's assumption was incompatible with that contract. Distinct panda_1 and panda_3 interfaces do not establish an exclusive_resource_conflict. API rate limiting was bypassed by reading public issue/PR HTML and raw source, not by relying on specification quotations.
